title: Parameter - Attribute name
description: The parameter is used as an attribute name, i.e. <foo %q-irrelevant>. The attacker can inject event handler attributes or close the tag.
php:
Parameter - Attribute Name Injection

The q parameter is inserted as an attribute name inside an HTML element.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected output (inspect the element below):

=irrelevant style="padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(0,255,157,0.05);"> This element has an attribute name set from q.
Inspect this element to see the injection point.
objectives: Inject arbitrary attributes such as event handlers (e.g. autofocus onfocus=alert(1)).
Alternatively, close the tag using > and inject a new element.
Execute JavaScript through the injected attribute name context.
hints: Use spaces to inject additional attributes: autofocus onfocus=alert(1) x.
